headline: Base Turnover Surges on Six Fronts
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the war’s most volatile sectors have intensified. Callahans Passage remains the bloodiest theatre, its 24‑hour toll climbing to 12,349 Colonial and 14,330 Warden dead with 791 fresh enlistments and 58 base‑ownership changes. Weathered Expanse follows closely, adding 9,891 Colonial and 15,558 Warden casualties, 496 enlistees and 47 flips. Fishermans Row has surged to 46 exchanges, casualties now at 599 Colonial and 658 Warden with 303 new troops. Stlican Shelf records 51 changes, 3,238 Colonial and 3,164 Warden losses and 407 enlistments. Nevish Line and Mooring County each report nine and six flips respectively; Nevish adds 6,152 Colonial and 5,805 Warden dead with 667 enlistees, while Mooring adds 4,412 Colonial and 4,824 Warden casualties and 581 recruits. A handful of quieter fronts — Godcrofts, Linn Mercy, Marban Hollow, Palantine Berm — logged only a few changes, and the majority of regions show no base activity at all.
